_comment: GitHub App manifest for the dedicated merge reviewer (FUL-37). Used with the App-manifest creation flow (see ops/PROVISION-REVIEWER.md). contents:write is REQUIRED (not optional): a GitHub App's approving review only counts toward required_approving_review_count if the App has repository WRITE access, and an App's write role requires contents:write (pull_requests:write needs contents:write under the hood). Verified the hard way on FUL-37: an App with contents:read produced a review with author_association:NONE that did NOT count, deadlocking count=1. The App still cannot push to main — enforce_admins:true + branch protection apply to it and it is in no bypass list; the workflow uses the token only to submit reviews. No webhook, single-repo install.
name: ffr-merge-reviewer
description: Second-party automated PR reviewer for fullstackforge-baileys-sidecar. Approves routine PRs on a green baileys-sidecar-gate so required_approving_review_count=1 can be enforced without a self-approval deadlock (FUL-37).
